name: Prayer For Healing
overview: Scripture reveals that healing is a divine promise from God to those who obey and trust Him, as He declares Himself the LORD who heals (Exodus 15:26). The Psalms express heartfelt cries for healing and affirm God's power to restore both physical and emotional wounds (Psalms 30:2; 147:3). Isaiah points to the suffering of Christ, whose wounds bring spiritual healing to believers (Isaiah 53:5), while Jeremiah models prayerful dependence on God’s healing and salvation (Jeremiah 17:14). The New Testament affirms that Jesus was empowered by the Holy Spirit to heal those oppressed by the enemy, demonstrating God’s active presence in restoration (Acts 10:38). Together, these verses encourage believers to seek God’s healing through faith and prayer, grounded in His redemptive work in Christ.
